experience_coverage.policy: Do not infer experience from first observed season.

fantasy_relevance_survival.warning: Production-percentile persistence only; not starter/depth/role survival.

uncertainty.warning: Production volatility only; explicit role-transition uncertainty is unavailable.

age_curve_findings.contract: Historical player-season age at September 1; not current age applied retrospectively.
age_curve_findings.DL: Production persistence remains meaningful into late 20s, with participation and conditional scoring decline becoming materially worse around ages 29-31 in the current sample.
age_curve_findings.LB: Strong early-career production but sharper late-20s/age-30 conditional decline and the largest observed year-over-year production volatility of the three groups.
age_curve_findings.DB: Meaningful early/mid-career persistence, but high-end relevance survival is weakest and age-30 conditional decline is pronounced in the current sample.

replacement_sensitivity_2025_reference_s.warning: Historical single-model-position sensitivity only. Not the Core/QA current-season hybrid-aware production replacement contract.

DL.evidence: Three-year rank persistence is strongest among the positions at lag 3, but no horizon is validated without chronological multi-year forecasting tests.

LB.evidence: Strongest one-year persistence, but faster decay and highest observed YoY volatility argue against copying DL/offense horizon assumptions.

DB.evidence: One-year persistence is meaningful, but weaker two/three-year stability and p75 relevance survival require separate horizon testing.

scoring_sensitivity.evidence: Existing league scoring tests prove tackle-heavy, pressure-heavy, and interception/pass-defense-heavy settings change positional scoring materially.
scoring_sensitivity.remaining: Re-score historical stat lines and re-estimate persistence/survival under target league scoring before freezing dynasty coefficients.

idp_flex_and_hybrids.reason: Point-in-time historical Sleeper eligibility is unavailable; current hybrid labels must not be applied retrospectively.

multi_year_surplus_architecture.concept: Position-specific expected multi-year league-scored fantasy surplus over league replacement, with survival, horizon, uncertainty, and any discount function independently validated for defense.

future_opportunity_adapter.join_contract: Stable player identity + point-in-time season/week; never overwrite historical state with current state.

blockers: historical rookie-year/entry-year metadata for experience curves
